title: The ticket stub, torn
logline: The ticket from the counter page with its stub torn off now, the tear ragged, on the seat beside the bag. Two pages of one ticket. The page draws the tear as the leaving.

panels.composition: Close on a bus seat with a canvas bag and beside it a paper ticket with its stub torn off along a ragged edge, patterned seat fabric.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, close on a bus seat with a canvas bag and a paper ticket with its stub torn off along a ragged edge beside it, patterned seat fabric, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
